guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 八里課程聚焦集水、初沉、污泥消化及放流介面，並把跨市流量與設備維護紀錄納入交接；不假設初沉已去除所有溶解污染。
guides.conceptEn: Bali focuses on collection, primary settling, digestion and discharge, including intermunicipal flow and asset records; primary settling is not assumed to remove every dissolved pollutant.
procedure: 先點選「跨市集污邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「尖峰流量配置」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把尖峰係數改成3，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 m³/s。與基準 2 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「進水提升設備」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「初級沉澱池」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「溶解與顆粒污染區分」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水改成60 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 70 %。與基準 80 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「污泥濃縮輸送」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把固體分率提高到0.20，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10000 kg/d。與基準 50000 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「蛋型消化槽模型」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把VS破壞率改成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1260 kg VS/d。與基準 1050 kg VS/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「消化氣計量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把已轉化COD改成800 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 280 Nm³ CH₄/d。與基準 350 Nm³ CH₄/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「移交儀表校驗」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「設備更新期間服務」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the intermunicipal collection boundary measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the peak-flow allocation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only the peak factor to3 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 m³/s. Compare with baseline 2 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the influent lift equipment measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the primary clarifier measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the dissolved/particulate distinction measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effluent to60 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 70 %. Compare with baseline 80 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the sludge thickening/transfer measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only solids fraction to0.20 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the egg-shaped digester model measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only VS destruction to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1260 kg VS/d. Compare with baseline 1050 kg VS/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the digester-gas metering measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only converted COD to800 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 280 Nm³ CH₄/d. Compare with baseline 350 Nm³ CH₄/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the handoff instrument checks measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the service during equipment renewal measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「跨市集污邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
把尖峰歷線疊在各單元可用能力上，找出最早溢流點。在離線場景為「尖峰流量配置」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「進水提升設備」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「初級沉澱池」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「溶解與顆粒污染區分」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「污泥濃縮輸送」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
測進出料TS與VS並檢查貯槽累積，避免以濃度差代替質量差。在離線場景為「蛋型消化槽模型」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
將氣量修正到同一溫壓，量測甲烷分率與溶解排出。在離線場景為「消化氣計量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「移交儀表校驗」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「設備更新期間服務」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for intermunicipal collection boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Overlay the peak hydrograph on available capacity for each unit and identify the first overflow point. Build an offline evidence table for peak-flow allocation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for influent lift equipment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for primary clarifier; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for dissolved/particulate distinction; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for sludge thickening/transfer; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure feed/digestate TS and VS and inspect storage accumulation; concentration difference is not mass difference. Build an offline evidence table for egg-shaped digester model; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Normalize gas volume to the same temperature/pressure and measure methane fraction and dissolved losses. Build an offline evidence table for digester-gas metering; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for handoff instrument checks; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for service during equipment renewal; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把設計總能力當成檢修時可用能力，會漏算停機風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以清水稀釋取代處理會讓濃度變低但不一定減少排放質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
進料量忽高忽低會讓單日去除率誤導。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把總沼氣量當純甲烷量會高估可用熱值。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Using installed capacity during maintenance overlooks unavailable equipment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Variable feeding makes a single-day destruction estimate misleading. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Treating total biogas as pure methane overestimates energy. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.
